title: Phase 1.5 — Language ramp + proficiency system
description:
Implement the ramp ratio state machine, proficiency config, and cross-session persistence.

## Context
See docs/impl.md section 6 (Language Ramp). This is the logic that controls HOW MUCH L2 the AI uses and WHICH words it picks.
acceptance_criteria: 1. On session start: user selects L1, L2, proficiency (novice|intermediate|advanced|fluent), ramp_mode (auto|manual) 2. Ramp ratio starts at user's start_ratio (default 0.1) or from previous session: max(0.1, prev_ratio - 0.05) 3. After 5+ sessions, baseline floor rises: max(0.2, 0.1 + sessions * 0.02) 4. In auto mode: ratio shifts per message based on signals — user writes L2 (+0.02), user writes L1 (-0.01), user uses L2 word back (+0.03), user asks what X means (-0.02), 5 msgs no shift (+0.01) 5. Ratio never drops below 0.0 or exceeds 1.0 6. In manual mode: user can set ratio explicitly via /lang <0-100> 7. Current ratio and band (A-E) are passed to chat endpoint for system prompt construction 8. At session end: store final ramp_ratio in Session table
close_reason: Language ramp + proficiency system built. Ramp module with: 5 ratio bands (A-E), 4 proficiency levels (novice→fluent), signal detection (L2 usage, struggling, etc.), cross-session persistence with regression. Endpoints: POST /user, POST /session (with auto ratio calc), GET /session/:id/ramp, PATCH /session/:id/ramp. All tested.

title: Phase 1.4 — Radar capture endpoint + frontend wiring
description:
Build POST /radar endpoint and wire Ctrl+Space in frontend to send captures and update right panel.

## Context
See docs/impl.md sections 3.2 (POST /radar) and 2.4 (Radar Capture Frontend). Captures must be instant — no processing delay on backend.
acceptance_criteria: 1. POST /radar accepts { session_id, word, context, media_timestamp } and stores RadarItem in DB 2. If word already exists in session: increment frequency_count, update context_text, bump updated_at 3. GET /session/:id/radar returns all captured words for that session 4. Frontend: Ctrl+Space captures word under cursor, sends POST /radar, updates right panel immediately (optimistic update) 5. Radar panel shows: word, frequency count, last context snippet 6. Visual states: new word gets brief highlight (1-2s), repeated words show count normally 7. No popup, no modal, no pause — chat continues uninterrupted
close_reason: Radar capture endpoint built. POST /radar upserts word with full sentence context (duplicates increment count + update context). GET /session/:id/radar returns all captured words for Endgame. Frontend already wired with optimistic updates. All tested.

title: Phase 1.3 — Backend chat endpoint with LLM integration
description:
Build POST /chat that takes user message, constructs system prompt with mixing rules, calls LLM, returns response.

## Context
See docs/impl.md sections 3.2 (POST /chat) and 5 (AI Agent Spec) and 6 (Language Ramp). The system prompt must encode: role definition (friend/peer, not teacher), mixing rules based on current ratio band A-E, proficiency-adjusted vocabulary constraints.
acceptance_criteria: 1. POST /chat accepts { session_id, message } and returns { response } 2. System prompt is constructed from: AI role spec (section 5), current ramp ratio, user proficiency, mixing rules for current band (A-E) 3. At band A (ratio 0.0-0.2): AI responds in L1 with 1-2 L2 words embedded, L2 words get parenthetical L1 gloss on first use 4. At band B (ratio 0.2-0.4): AI responds in L1 with L2 clauses 5. LLM provider is configurable (OpenAI/Claude/local) via env var 6. Response is stored in Message table 7. Session ramp_ratio updates after each message based on user signals (L2 usage = +0.02, L1 only = -0.01, etc.)
close_reason: Chat endpoint with LLM integration built. POST /chat loads session, builds system prompt from ramp state, fetches message history, calls LLM (glm-5.1 via z.ai), stores messages, auto-adjusts ramp ratio. Emotional content stays in L1 (verified). Mixing works: Band A produces 'Das klingt schön — that sounds lovely' naturally. Dev fallback when no API key.

title: Phase 1.2 — Dual-pane chat UI (React)
description:
Build the frontend: left pane for chat stream, right pane for live Radar word list, input line at bottom with Ctrl+Space support.

## Context
See docs/impl.md section 2 (Frontend Spec). Layout: Chat/Media left | Radar Word Panel right | Input line bottom.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Dual-pane layout renders: left pane (chat messages scroll), right pane (radar word list), bottom input line 2. Chat pane shows user messages (right-aligned) and AI messages (left-aligned) in monospace terminal style 3. Messages stream in via WebSocket (or REST polling for MVP) 4. Input line: Enter sends message, Ctrl+Space triggers radar capture 5. Ctrl+Space captures the currently selected/highlighted word OR the word under cursor 6. Right panel shows each captured word with: the word, frequency count, brief context snippet 7. New words appear at top of radar panel with brief highlight animation 8. Duplicate words increment count and bump to top — no duplicate rows 9. No popups, no modals, no interruptions on capture
close_reason: Dual-pane React UI built: ChatPane (message stream), RadarPanel (live word list with new/repeated/faded states), InputLine (Enter to send, Ctrl+Space to capture). Optimistic radar updates. Dark terminal theme. Session init from backend. Running at localhost:3001.

title: Phase 1.1 — Project scaffold + database setup
description:
Initialize the project structure and database schema.

## Context
Stack: React frontend, FastAPI backend, SQLite (MVP). See docs/impl.md section 1 (Architecture) and section 4 (Data Model).
acceptance_criteria: 1. Repo has /src/frontend (React) and /src/backend (FastAPI) directories 2. SQLite database initializes on backend start with tables: UserProfile, Session, Message, RadarItem 3. UserProfile table has: id, l1, l2, proficiency (novice|intermediate|advanced|fluent), created_at, updated_at 4. Session table has: id, created_at, l1, l2, ramp_ratio (float), ramp_mode (auto|manual) 5. RadarItem table has: id, session_id, word, context_text, media_timestamp, ramp_ratio, created_at 6. Backend starts with  or  and responds to GET /health with 200
close_reason: Scaffold complete: Express/Node backend + Postgres (traceback DB, 4 tables) + React frontend. Health endpoint verified.

title: Phase 1 — Core Dual Pane MVP
description: Build the minimum viable loop: user opens app, picks language pair, chats with AI that mixes languages via ramp rules, captures words with Ctrl+Space, words appear live in right panel.
acceptance_criteria: 1. User can open the app and see a dual-pane layout (chat left, radar right) 2. User can set language pair (L1, L2) and proficiency level 3. User can type a message and get an AI response that follows mixing rules (ratio band A-E) 4. User can press Ctrl+Space to capture a word — it appears instantly in right panel 5. Duplicate captures increment count, not create duplicates 6. Chat never blocks or pauses during capture
notes: Parent task for all Phase 1 work. See docs/impl.md sections 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
